title: Electromagnetic wave
back: E along y, B along z, in phase; the wave travels along E × B at c.

title: Displacement current
back: In the gap of a charging capacitor the changing E acts as i_d = ε₀ dΦ_E/dt = i_c.

title: The EM spectrum
back: Radio, micro, IR, visible, UV, X, γ: frequency up, wavelength down. All at c in vacuum.

title: Speed of EM waves
back: 3 × 10⁸ m/s in vacuum for every wavelength.

title: Ratio of field amplitudes
back: E and B are in phase.

title: Wave relation
back: Frequency is set by the source and does not change in a medium.

title: Which wave for which job?
back: Radar, ovens: microwaves. Remote controls, physiotherapy: IR. Water purification, LASIK: UV. Bones: X-rays. Cancer treatment: γ.

title: Order of the EM spectrum
back: "Raging Martians Invaded Venus Using X-ray Guns": radio → gamma, increasing frequency.
